title: Regularity Properties of Nuclear $C^*$-Algebras
exact_target: For a separable unital simple nuclear stably finite infinite-dimensional $C^*$-algebra $A$, are the following equivalent: $\mathcal Z$-stability ($A\cong A\otimes\mathcal Z$), strict comparison, and finite decomposition rank?
